title: HDF Common Primitives
description: Shared building blocks used by hdf-results and hdf-baseline schemas.

Hash_Algorithm.description: Supported cryptographic hash algorithms for checksums and integrity verification.
Hash_Algorithm.title: Hash Algorithm

id.description: The unique identifier for the group. Example: the relative path to the file specifying the requirements.

title.description: The title of the group - should be human readable.

requirements.description: The set of requirements as specified by their ids in this group. Example: 'SV-238196'.

Requirement_Group.description: Describes a group of requirements, such as those defined in a single file.
Requirement_Group.title: Requirement Group

branch.description: The branch name for a git repo.

path.description: The relative path if the dependency is locally available.

statusMessage.description: The reason for the status if it is 'failed' or 'skipped'.

git.description: The location of the git repo. Example: 'https://github.com/my-org/ubuntu-22.04-stig-baseline.git'.

supermarket.description: The 'user/profilename' attribute for a Supermarket server.

compliance.description: The 'user/profilename' attribute for an Automate server.

Dependency.description: A dependency for a baseline. Can include relative paths or URLs for where to find the dependency.
Dependency.title: Dependency

anyOf.description: A human readable/meaningful reference. Example: a book title.
A URL pointing at the reference.
A URI pointing at the reference.

Reference.description: A reference to an external document.
Reference.title: Reference

ref.description: Path to the file that this requirement originates from.

line.description: The line on which this requirement is located.

Source_Location.description: The explicit location of a requirement within source code.
Source_Location.title: Source Location

platformName.description: The platform name - can include wildcards. Example: 'debian'.

platform.description: The location of the platform. Can be: 'os', 'aws', 'azure', or 'gcp'.

release.description: The release of the platform. Example: '20.04' for 'ubuntu'.

Supported_Platform.description: A supported platform target. Example: the platform name being 'ubuntu'.
Supported_Platform.title: Supported Platform

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used for the checksum.

Checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum for baseline integrity verification.
Checksum.title: Checksum
